summary: Nu Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a US$1.0 billion share repurchase program authorized by its board. The program allows repurchases of Class A ordinary shares in open market or privately negotiated transactions over 12 months ending June 3, 2027. Repurchases may use Rule 10b-18 and 10b5-1 plans, funded from cash balances. Shares will be retained in treasury or canceled. No specific price, premium, or commitment to acquire any number of shares is stated. Watch for execution pace and potential program size adjustments.
